title: Chief Executive Order 10 Provisional Constitution Second Amendment Order 2000

sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 10 Provisional Constitution Second Amendment Order 2000
sections.description:
PROVISIONAL CONSTITUTION (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2000
PROVISIONAL
CONSTITUTION (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2000
CHIEF EXECUTIVE ORDER
10 OF 2000
An Order further
to amend the Provisional Constitution Order No. 1 of 1999
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 14th November, 2000]
No.2-10/99-Min-I, dated 14-11-2000.---Whereas
it is expedient further to amend the Provisional Constitution Order No. 1 of
1999 for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This order may be called the Provisional Constitution
(Amendment) Order; 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the fourteenth day of
October, 1999.

10 OF 2000
An Order further
to amend the Provisional Constitution Order No. 1 of 1999
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 14th November, 2000]
No.2-10/99-Min-I, dated 14-11-2000.---Whereas
it is expedient further to amend the Provisional Constitution Order No. 1 of
1999 for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
2. Amendment of Article 5,
Order 1 of 1999.---In the Provisional Constitution Order No. 1 of 1999, the
existing Article 5 shall be re-number as clause (1) of that Article and after
clause (1) re-numbered as aforesaid, the following clause shall be added,
namely:--
"(2) In all laws including
all Acts, Ordinances, Orders, Rules, Bye-laws Regulations, Notifications and all
other legal instruments in force in and part of Pakistan whether made by the
President or the Governor of Province, the words "Prime Minister" and
the words "Chief Minister wherever occurring, shall be deemed substituted
by the words "Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan"
and "Government respectively."
